Actors and Directors Who Cooperated At Least Three Times

https://leetcode.com/problems/actors-and-directors-who-cooperated-at-least-three-times/description/

Solved on 2026-08-29

Write a solution to find all the pairs (actor_id, director_id) where the actor has cooperated with the director at least three times.

Return the result table in any order.

## Solution

```{sql}
-- Write your PostgreSQL query statement below
SELECT
    actor_id,
    director_id
FROM
    ActorDirector
GROUP BY
    actor_id,
    director_id
    HAVING  COUNT(*) >= 3
;
```

## Explanation

The GROUP BY clause groups the results by actor_id and director_id, and the HAVING clause filters the groups to only include those where the count of cooperations is at least three.
